text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I lost the Yushun Himba (Oaks)...! 
However, a true princess must look forward 
and charge straight toward her happy 
ending!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I mean, everyone is cheering for me! I'm 
the true star! No one besides me is worthy 
of being called a princess!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'm taking the Shuka Sho by 
sheer guts and grit! Time for a 
spirit-infused Princess☆Upper, desu wa~~!
